$comment: GENESIS ships, launches, world events and cameras (render lane, phase 4b) on the lookdev world's fabricated missions and world events (src/client/lookdevspace.ts). Each params string is its own page (its own world); shots of one page follow one world through time. Scripts on dev=1 pages place cameras from the ship layer's own state. Steps that time an effect in seconds at 1× (a burst, an explosion, the hold-down) are written for TICKS_PER_SECOND_1X = 1 (LIVING §1.1: G.step(1.6) is 1.6 s of the burst); steps that place a ship on its climb stay in ticks. Run: node _harness/shots.mjs _harness/specs/ships.json --port=5199

shots.name: moon-falling
shots.script: const m = await import('/src/render/fx/worlds.ts'); return JSON.stringify(m.WORLD_FX.last.detail());

shots.name: launch-t0
script: await G.frames(2); const A = window.__GENESIS_APP__; const t = A.renderer.ships.tracks.get(1002);
// the hero framing: from the side of the flame trench's main exit, swung round so the gantry stands beside the rocket and the tanks show
const yaw = t.padYaw * 180 / Math.PI + 220;
await G.camera({ mode: 'photo', target: { kind: 'ship', id: 1002 }, dist: 190, yaw, alt: 4, pitch: 9, fov: 55, hour: 18.2 }); await G.frames(3);
const m = await import('/src/render/fx/launch.ts'); return JSON.stringify({ yaw: Math.round(yaw), st: m.LAUNCH_FX.last && m.LAUNCH_FX.last.stats() });

shots.name: launch-t2
shots.script: const m = await import('/src/render/fx/launch.ts'); return JSON.stringify(m.LAUNCH_FX.last.stats());

shots.name: launch-t8
script: const A = window.__GENESIS_APP__; const t = A.renderer.ships.tracks.get(1002); const d = t.padDir, g = t.padGround;
await A.setLocalHour(19.6, Math.atan2(d[0], d[2]) * 180 / Math.PI);

A.rig.modes.applySpec({ mode: 'photo', planet: 0, lat: 0, lon: 0, target: null, focusPoint: [d[0] * (g + 260), d[1] * (g + 260), d[2] * (g + 260)], dist: 700, yaw: 150, alt: 40, pitch: 1, fov: 62 }, A.sim.view);
A.setUi(false); A.renderer.cut(); await G.frames(1);
const sv = A.sim.view.ships.find((s) => s.id === 1002); return JSON.stringify({ phase: sv && sv.phase, progress: sv && sv.progress });

shots.name: launch-fail
script: await G.step(4); await G.frames(1); await G.step(5); await G.frames(1); await G.step(0.8);

const sv = window.__GENESIS_APP__.sim.view.ships.find((s) => s.id === 1007); const m = await import('/src/render/fx/launch.ts'); return JSON.stringify({ phase: sv && sv.phase, fx: m.LAUNCH_FX.last.stats() });

shots.name: cracked-rift
script: const m = await import('/src/render/fx/worlds.ts'); const cv = m.WORLD_FX.last.cracks.get(0);
const p = cv.mesh.geometry.getAttribute('position'); const i = Math.floor(p.count * 0.12 / 7) * 7 + 3;
const x = p.getX(i), y = p.getY(i), z = p.getZ(i); const l = Math.hypot(x, y, z);
const lat = Math.asin(y / l) * 180 / Math.PI, lon = Math.atan2(x, z) * 180 / Math.PI;
await G.camera({ mode: 'orbit', planet: 0, lat, lon, dist: 1600, tilt: 55, yaw: 20, hour: 21.5 }); await G.frames(2);
return JSON.stringify({ lat: +lat.toFixed(1), lon: +lon.toFixed(1), fx: m.WORLD_FX.last.stats() });

shots.name: world-erase-flash
shots.script: await G.cmd({ k: 'world.erase', world: 3 }); await G.step(1.6);

shots.name: world-birth
script: const r = await G.cmd({ k: 'world.birth', kind: 'desert', distance: 1.3, name: 'Nova' });
await G.step(0.2); await G.frames(2);
await G.camera({ mode: 'orbit', planet: r.created[0].id, lat: 15, lon: 0, dist: 9000, tilt: 40 });
await G.step(3);

shots.name: photo-dof
script: const A = window.__GENESIS_APP__; let best = null;

for (let y = 200; y <= 480; y += 16) for (let x = 180; x <= 780; x += 16) { const h = G.pickAt(x, y); if (h && h.kind === 'agent' && h.dist > 4 && (!best || h.dist < best.d)) best = { d: h.dist, x, y }; }
const { PHOTO } = await import('/src/render/camera/photo.ts');
if (best) A.rig.modes.lens({ ...PHOTO.lens, focus: best.d, blur: 0.85 });
return JSON.stringify({ focusOn: best, lens: { focus: PHOTO.lens.focus, blur: PHOTO.lens.blur, on: PHOTO.on } });
